name: recto
description: Create concise course explanations in the user's language with key source-language terms. Deliver Markdown, Typst, and PDF by default, with editable Word on request.

interface.longDescription: Create concise course explanations with study-notes, adapting the main language and key source-language terms to the learner. Use recto to preserve finished content while delivering Markdown, Typst, and PDF with shared media and only necessary resources. Add editable Word when requested.
